note: A value carried from the fund's own records.
Canonical asset class and strategy are deterministic outputs of context-grouping-map.csv.
A blank vintage year takes a hash of the run seed and fund ID spread across the configured base year and span; no page states it and no median is computed.
A blank strategy takes the configured fallback constant; the name keyword branch is retired and stays on name_hint.
A canonical class derived from the configured fallback cites no source page.

A value copied onto a completed row from a fund_master cell this stage imputed is the same imputed value, so every lineage row that carries it reads IMPUTED and repeats the master cell's imputation method.
The change_type promotion writes in attribute-changes.csv for a canonical cell it reads off context-grouping-map.csv; the cell is a reading of a printed word, not a copy of one.
The rule_id prefix on that row; the rest of the id is the matrix row's context and its printed input_value.
A canonical cell promotion filled and this stage carries unchanged is derived from a printed word, so its lineage row reads DERIVED and cites the attribute-changes row promotion wrote.
An absent base currency uses the reported fund-size denomination or currency_fallback for the generated demonstration; it remains IMPUTED.
An absent fund-size currency takes currency_fallback from integrated_completion.yml and remains IMPUTED.
An absent status takes the fund_status row in integrated-master-defaults.csv.
An absent size uses the greater of the extracted median and configured fallback multiplied by the seeded scale from integrated-master-defaults.csv.
